data.name: Gajaadhar
data.gender_notes: Gajaadhar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Gajaadhar is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Gaja' (elephant) and 'Adhara' (holder). This name is associated with the mythological figure Gajendra, who was a human being who was saved from the king of elephants, Indra. The name symbolizes strength, courage, and protection. The name Gajaadhar carries the meaning “Elephant-holder” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Gajaadhar usually hope their child will grow to embody elephant-holder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Gajaadhar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Elephant-holder.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gajaadhar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
